name: Camping 101: Enchanting
summary: Enchanters can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute for a camp. Speak with Vance Undergloom in Brill after showing proficiency in your skill.

sections.title: A Camp Companion
sections.body: Enchanters are welcome at camps in the wilds. You can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute to bring entertainment during time away from the trail.

faq.q: What can I learn to craft?
faq.answer: You can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp.

faq.q: Who teaches me about the lute?
faq.answer: Vance Undergloom in Brill can teach you to craft the Enchanted Lute.

faq.q: Where do I find Vance Undergloom?
What do I need before speaking with Vance?
faq.answer: You need to show proficiency in your skill before learning to craft the camping item.

faq.q: Why bring an Enchanted Lute to camp?
faq.answer: The Enchanted Lute provides entertainment during your downtime at camp.

angles.text: As an enchanter, you can learn to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp after showing proficiency in your skill.
